_README: Prices in US dollars per MILLION tokens. Edit this file to correct the
bill; the admin page multiplies at read time, so a correction here fixes
every past row rather than only new ones.
A model with no entry is NOT free. It reports its tokens and shows
'price not set', because a zero would understate the invoice and the
page would look like it was working.
'cached_input_per_mtok' is optional. Left out, cached input is billed at
the full input rate, which overstates rather than understates.
Matching: exact model id first, then the longest prefix here. So a
'gpt-6-luna' entry covers 'gpt-6-luna-2026-01-15' without a row per

gpt-6-luna._note: LLM_CAPTION_MODEL default. Standard short-context tier, looked up 2026-10-22; several trackers agree. NOT covered here: cache WRITES bill at 0.125/Mtok, and a request over 272K input tokens reprices the WHOLE request at long-context rates (0.20 in / 0.75 out), so a very long prompt is under-counted. Caption prompts are a few thousand tokens, so neither applies today. Batch and Flex tiers are half of these.

gpt-4o-mini._note: Named in CLAUDE.md as the historical caption model. Left unset deliberately: if it turns out to still be called, the page will SAY the total excludes it rather than quietly pricing it at a rate I did not verify.

_fx: USD->INR is NOT configured here on purpose. A single rate would convert
a whole window at one number, and the pair moved 96.78 -> 94.47 over the
three weeks to 2026-10-22. Each day's spend is converted at that day's
published rate instead, fetched per date by services/fx_rates.py from
the ECB via Frankfurter and cached in the fx_rates collection.
